quests.title: Lunch at the Frontier
quests.summary: Carmen has crossed to work on the Rock for nineteen years, and today she's left her lunch at her mother's bar.

steps.text: Fetch Carmen's lunch from her mother, Pilar, at Bar Pilar in La Línea.
Take it back to Carmen in the frontier queue, and deal with the van driver who's in a mood.

quests.reward: Tortillitas de Camarones, Churros con Chocolate and standing with the Overseas Territories.
